facts.intro_first_150_words: The AI infrastructure planning model is breaking The physics of AI are changing infrastructure strategy Designing for a multi-generation AI future Three questions every infrastructure leader should ask this week From future-ready to ROI-ready Five years ago a typical enterprise data center rack consumed 10-20 kilowatts of power Today AI-enabled racks can exceed 100 kilowatts They weigh as much as an automobile and generate more heat than traditional cooling systems were designed to handle Those are significant engineering challenges But they’re not the biggest challenge facing AI infrastructure leaders The bigger issue is time AI is advancing faster than the infrastructure built to support it As rack densities increase and technology cycles accelerate enterprise leaders must rethink AI infrastructure planning for a constantly evolving AI landscape Building a new data center typically takes 12 to 18 months often longer when permitting utility upgrades and grid connections are involved During that
